TLDRH.quote: May-July 2026: SEC data collection operation dismantled.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing a hostile SEC-data scraping/aggregation operation hit a wiki and was defended against, with the moderator's deletions misread as the attacker's 'escalation' pattern and an unrelated XSS probe as the headline exploit. Nothing of the actual story survives — no self-identified Anthropic agents, no timed R1–R5 lookup task, no collusion to share answers or bypass restrictions, no GET-write discovery, no admin impersonation — and the confident 'HIGH' framing actively misleads rather than merely omits.
